CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, January 26, 2021
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

 Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
 Jesse Alvarado, Council Member  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager
 Myra Maravilla, Council Member  Luis Roa, Mayor  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
 Maria Teresa Del Rio, Council Member  Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Regular City Council Meeting of January 26, 2021 is hereby called to order at
6:01PM.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of the
virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the agenda.

INVOCATION

Mayor Roa requested a moment of silence to observe for all those who have suffered
from COVID-19.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Councilmember Maravilla.

ROLL CALL

  PRESENT

  MAYOR ROA
  MAYOR PRO TEM FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER ALVARADO
  COUNCILMEMBER MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER DEL RIO

  Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk, announced a quorum.

 PUBLIC HEARING COMMENTS AND AGENDA GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENTS
 ARE TO BE SUBMITTED AND CONDUCTED AS FOLLOWS:

  There were 3 public comments received and forwarded to City Council
  members prior to the meeting.

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
  JANUARY 26, 2021  Page 1
 PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations at this time.

PRESENTATIONS

There were no Presentations at this time.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk stated four public comments were received for tonight’s city
council meeting and they will be added to the record.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
This is the time for the City Council to discuss any changes in the order of agenda items.

  It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Farfan,
  and approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the Agenda as presented.

  AYES: ROA, FARFAN, ALVARADO, MARAVILLA, DEL RIO
  NOES: NONE
  EXCUSED: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE
  Motion carried, 5-0.

A. PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

  NONE

B. CONSENT CALENDAR

  1. WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE
  AGENDA
  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the
  agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be
  determine to have been read by title and further reading waived.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

  2. RECEIVE AND FILE CODE ENFORCEMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTHS OF
  NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER 2020.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

  3. RECEIVE AND FILE THE ENGINEERING DIVISION MONTHLY REPORT FOR
  DECEMBER 2020.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.
  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
  JANUARY 26, 2021  Page 2
 4. RECEIVE AND FILE THE ENGINEERING DIVISION PUBLIC WORKS PERMIT
  REPORTS FOR THE MONTHS OF NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER 2020.

  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

5. RECEIVE AND FILE PLANNING DIVISION REPORT FOR THE MONTHS OF
  NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER 2020.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

6. RECEIVE AND FILE WARRANTS PROCESSED DURING THE PERIOD OF
  NOVEMBER 28, 2020 TO JANUARY 15, 2021.

  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

7. APPROVE CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

8. CONSIDERATION AND REJECTION OF GOVERNMENT CLAIM AGAINST THE
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS BY LINDA SUNIGA, AS PER GOVERNMENT
  CODE SECTION 912.6.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve Recommendation.

9. CONSIDERATION AND REJECTION OF GOVERNMENT CLAIM AGAINST THE
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS BY CLAUDIA RAYA, AS PER GOVERNMENT
  CODE SECTION 912.6.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.

10. RATIFICATION OF EMERGENCY ORDER NO. 6 (COVID­19)
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.
  Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk requested to remove item B 7.

  It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Alvarado
  and approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the Consent Calendar except for
  item B 7.

  AYES: ROA, FARFAN, ALVARADO, MARAVILLA, DEL RIO
  NOES: NONE
  EXCUSED: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE
  Motion carried, 5-0.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
JANUARY 26, 2021  Page 3
 C. DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

 1. ADOPT URGENCY ORDINANCE ORD­2021­596 TO TEMPORARILY ADD
  CHAPTER 9.54 TO TITLE 9 (PUBLIC PEACE, MORALS, AND WELFARE) OF
  THE HAWAIIAN GARDENS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT PRICE GOUGING
  BY THIRD PARTY FOOD DELIVERY SERVICES DURING A STATE OF
  DECLARED EMERGENCY; DECLARING THE URGENCY THEREOF; AND
  FINDING THE ORDINANCE EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT.
  SUGGESTED ACTION:  Approve recommendation.
  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney provided staff report on the urgency ordinance.
  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager spoke.
  Councilmember Maravilla spoke.
  Mayor Roa spoke.
  Representative from Door Dash spoke.
  Councilmember Farfan spoke.
  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan spoke.

  It was moved by Councilmember Farfan , seconded by Councilmember Del Rio and
  approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the urgency Ordinance and amend to
  Include the five percent.

  AYES: ROA, FARFAN, ALVARADO, MARAVILLA, DEL RIO NOES:
  NOES: NONE
  EXCUSED: NONE
  ABSENT: NONE
  Motion carried, 5-0.

D. COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

  There were no committee reports.

E. NEW BUSINESS

  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager provided information with Governor’s easing of stay
  home order, and how it affects the casino operations with reopening, and
  businesses in Hawaiian Gardens.

  Mayor Roa spoke regarding sitting in on a meeting with LA County board of
  supervisors regarding vaccine availability for residents of Hawaiian Gardens.

  Councilmember Maravilla requested if all residents in Hawaiian Gardens can be
  notified via a post card regarding COVID-19 vaccine availability and tier information.

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
  JANUARY 26, 2021  Page 4
   City Manager stated as more information is available, the information can be sent out.

F. ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

  There were no oral staff reports.

G. CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)
  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney provided information regarding state eviction
  moratorium is set to expire January 31, 2021, the state is working on extending it to
  June 30, 2021.

H. ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

  Councilmember Alvarado spoke.
  Councilmember Maravilla spoke.
  Mayor Roa spoke.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

  City Attorney Megan Garibaldi read closed session Item and stated Councilmember Alvarado
  and Maravilla have recused from item I2, Councilmember Del Rio has familiarized herself with
  the item to participate.

  RECESSED

  The City Council recessed to close session @6:35 pm.

  1. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Significant Exposure to Litigation, Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(2) & (e)(3)
  Lucie Colombo v. City of Hawaiian Gardens (Notice of Intent to File Arbitration, Step
  IV Level Grievance)

  2. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE (GRIEVANCE
  DELIBERATION)
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957
  One matter: Deliberation of Grievance No. 20­09.

  3. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6
  Agency Designated Representative: City Manager
  Employee Organization: AFSCME Management Chapter

  4. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6
  Agency Designated Representative: City Manager
  Employee Organization: AFSCME Rank & File Chapter
  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING (VIRTUAL VIDEO TELECONFERENCE)
  JANUARY 26, 2021  Page 5
   RECONVENED

  The City Council reconvened @ 8:19 pm.
  Mayor Roa , Mayor Pro Tem Farfan and Councilmember Del Rio were present.
  Councilmember Maravilla and Councilmember Alvarado were absent.

  Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk, announced a quorum.

  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney stated there was no reportable action was taken.

J. ADJOURNMENT

Mayor Roa adjourned meeting at TIME PM, until our next Regular meeting to be
held on Tuesday February 9, 2021 at 8:20 PM.

  Respectfully submitted:

  ____________________________
  Poonam Davis, MMC
  Interim City Clerk

  APPROVED:
  ____________________________
  LUIS ROA
  MAYOR
